final: WITH dc AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM account WHERE district_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY district_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM dc WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), sh AS (SELECT dc.district_id, dc.cnt, CAST(dc.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total AS share FROM dc JOIN tot ON tot.total IS NOT NULL), avgsh AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh WHERE share IS NOT NULL), res AS (SELECT sh.district_id, sh.cnt, sh.share, sh.share - avgsh.avg_share AS diff FROM sh JOIN avgsh ON avgsh.avg_share IS NOT NULL) SELECT district_id, cnt, share, diff FROM res ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
